reviews.text: Darren has completely transformed life with my rescue Daisy. I was struggling to walk her because she had never been lead trained and was very reactive to other dogs, now we enjoy two walks a day! Darren is so incredibly intuitive and it’s clear he was born to work with dogs. His knowledge is immense and I really felt like it was value for money. I received so much support from the group sessions and the Q&As zooms. Also his method of having all of his videos on the app makes it so easy to learn and revisit topics as they come up. It was hard work to be consistent with the training but the reward is well worth the hard work and now it’s easy to keep on top of training. Cannot thank Darren enough, don’t hesitate to book. You won’t regret it!

If I could give 100 stars for Darren at FETCH I would for the help and guidance he has given us with our reactive rescue pup Loki!
From th moment I started researching trainers and FETCH came up, it was clear as day Darren not only adores dogs but he can also read them so well and know what they need in terms of training, play and general care.
We’ve just finished our training program and hand on my heart can say we are leaving with a much happier calmer (as calm as a working breed pup can be🤣) content dog, we’ve learnt so much about working dogs and their need for drive, stimulation and play and cannot get over how much Loki has improved, our first session with Darren and he’d already had us nailing loose leash walking! Magic touch he has!!
We will miss going on Tuesday down to Middleton but Loki will be back to use the dog hotel which I’ve no doubt he’ll go sky rocketing into during the summer
Thank you for everything Darren.

I brought my lab pup to Darren in March and was delighted with the training and professionalism, he was very honest when needed (that I require training as much as the dog 😂) and we made great progress! You can tell he really cares for animals! We’ve Luna booked into board with him this weekend and from the looks of his dog hotel she’s in for a lovely holiday 😊 couldn’t recommend more!!

We worked with Darren with our dog Evie who reacts at all dogs by lunging and barking when out on a walk. We did 4 sessions and worked on our marker word, walking, keeping Evie’s attention on us, lay, recall words. The 4 sessions were very well structured and helpful. Evie now focuses on us a lot more when out walking and reacts to the marker word and it has been a huge help when out walking and when we come across other dogs. Darren is very knowledgeable and made training easy for us and Evie was happy going to training and happy to work with Darren and get lots of treats. Would highly recommend Darren for training.

Darren has helped me with 2 dogs now and he is absolutely fantastic.
We came to him first with our reactive mastiffx. Darren was so patient, knowledgeable and kind to our boy and made so much progress with him. At the end of our training, we were able to we walk past other dogs with minimal fuss!

We also brought our bulldog puppy to Darren and this was a game changer. He gave us the tools and confidence to raise a very happy pup who we have a great bond with. It's the most work I've put into a pup but also the most fun and rewarding experience!

I sent a friend who had a Berneese Mountain Dog to Darren. My friend was due to have back surgery and so it was very important that he wasn't pulled around walking the dog. The 58kg dog now walks like a dream, no issues at all and is so gentle and calm.

Highly highly recommend Darren for dogs of all shapes and sizes!

My dog Juno has been staying a few days at the Fetch Dog Hotel over the past 2 weeks due to work commitments I have. I expected the second drop off to be a bit more testing because Juno has separation anxiety and typically does not like me leaving her anywhere, let alone over night.
I was pleasantly shocked when I got her out of the car to drop her off this morning she was so excited to get inside that she nearly dragged me across the yard! Her tail was wagging like mad and she wasn't even bothered with me once Darren showed up. This is testament to the level of care and attention Darren gives all dogs under his care.
She has gone to other kennels before and has come home totally out of sorts, whereas she came home wrecked tired from all the fun she had and to see her so eager to return when she knows she is going to be left there was such a relief for me. I could not recommend Fetch Dog Training Services enough.
Fantastic, friendly. Izzie loves going there. Would recommend Darren to anyone.

Going to Darren with my dog Benny was the best decision ever. He has so much knowledge, patience and love for dogs. I can see huge improvement in Benny and in my own relationship with him. Walks and a pure pleasure now as we are both more confident. Looking forward to our next session.

We first came to Darren in a panic after our 2 year old rescue collie was labelled aggressive at daycare and sent home. After seeing her for a few minutes he was immediately able to tell she wasn’t aggressive at all and in fact, he referred her to a vet for anxiety medicine which has completely transformed her (and our) quality of life. After working with her for a bit longer, Darren noticed an unusual pattern in her coat which he suspected might be related to underlying pain which numerous vets didn’t notice and when we raised it to our vet, after a pain medication trial, they suspect she has a some nerve pain which is likely causing some of the behaviours she was labelled ‘aggressive’ for in the first place!

I don’t know where we’d be today without Darren’s help and support. The kindness, compassion, empathy and wealth of knowledge he brings to every session is just priceless. I don’t think we’ll ever run out of things to learn from him. He is an incredible dog whisperer and person. We are endlessly grateful to you, Darren! 🙏🏼

We brought our dog (Rocket!🚀) to Darren for the 1 month training and thought it was absolutely fantastic.  Every session is tailored to your dog, you, and the progress you have both been making.
I was most impressed by how I was taught to read my dog's signals.  They are always communicating!  "Did you see that?" "What happened there? You have his attention!" - being able to pick up on more of what my dog is telling me has definitely strengthened our connection.
Darren has such confidence and clarity in his training sessions, and our dog loved his visits out to the training yard.
We have so much more focused and fun walks together as a result of the progress we made at F.E.T.C.H.
